english.title: Fail to comply with deduction from earnings order - Child Support Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with the requirements of

(A)_[a deduction from earnings order]_
(B)_[a regulation made under section 32 of the Child Support Act 1991 designated for the purposes of section 32(8) of the Act]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 32(8) and (11) of the Child Support Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed to comply with the requirements of a deduction from earnings order OR
a regulation made under section 32 of the Act designated for the purposes of subsection 32(8) of the Act

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 32(9) of the Child Support Act 1991 provides that in section 32(8) "designated" means designated by the regulations.
(ii) Section 32(10) of the Child Support Act 1991 provides that it shall be a defence for a person charged with this offence to prove that he took all reasonable steps to comply with the requirements in question.

A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
